mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Reddan Soccer Park and a waxing crescent moon. If you are an early bird, the space station will be visible tomorrow morning, rising over Belleville and heading toward Fitchburg, appearing low on the horizon for 4 minutes starting at 4:47 AM. Overnight, we expect a low of 60 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Senior Center is actively recruiting volunteers for several roles, with a preference for a two-visit monthly commitment. Additionally, please be advised that road construction on Highway M begins August 18, which will shift traffic patterns and include a temporary closure of the driveway serving Alliant and Kwik Trip.

It is a busy few days in town! Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, or take the kids to the Verona Ice Arena for the Girls Try Hockey event. Tomorrow, Epic Systems hosts their annual UGM, and Insight Wellness offers yoga classes. Looking ahead, Tuesday brings trivia nights to Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee.

In a report covering the week of August 3 to August 10, police noted that on Saturday, an officer located two juveniles on Barbara Street who were cited for underage alcohol consumption and violating curfew.
The flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. Culver's is open until 10 PM, so you have less than 60 minutes left to grab a scoop before they close for the night.
